breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the distributed-load case with its midspan resultant when computing deflection, but an equivalent resultant does not preserve beam deflection behavior.
breakdown.reason: The Agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The original error was instructing the user to replace the distributed load with its single resultant force to calculate deflection, which is physically incorrect. The ground truth corrects this by removing the erroneous instruction. The Agent, however, kept and reinforced this incorrect method, stating: 'For the distributed load contribution, replace the uniform load with its single resultant wL acting at midspan.'
